decision.summary: NO_ACTION: BTC has firmed above 78k, but the noon board still does not show the clear bullish structure Beecthor wanted before taking a long.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Account state and trade log remain coherent and flat, so there is nothing to close or reduce. The latest Beecthor transcript and summary still frame 77k-78k as the key battlefield: hold it and BTC can rebound toward 82k, lose it and the bearish path toward 68k reopens, but he explicitly does not want longs by inertia without a clearer recovery structure. The latest available pre-cycle snapshot at 2026-05-17T11:55:14Z shows BTC spot around 78386.41, with will-bitcoin-reach-79k-on-may-17 Yes repriced to about 0.585 and will-bitcoin-dip-to-77k-on-may-17 Yes down to about 0.235. That weakens the bearish daily candidate, but the upside move still looks like modest drift above support rather than a clean breakout and acceptance that overrides the playbook's range-lock bias. With no open positions to manage and no clearly confirmed same-day edge, waiting remains the better decision.
